mapper.select: -- 운영 목적 전체를 집계한다. source/job/plan은 별도 분모이며 join 증식·페이지 제한·성공 추정이 없다. WITH sources AS ( SELECT count(1) AS bound_source_count,count(1) FILTER (WHERE s.is_attachment_review_required) AS review_required_source_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE s.current_attachment_evaluation_id IS NOT NULL) AS effective_attachment_source_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_links l WHERE l.source_id=s.id)) AS linked_source_count FROM announcement_source_snapshots s JOIN announcement_attachment_policies p ON p.id=s.attachment_policy_id WHERE s.data_purpose_code='PRODUCTION' AND p.rule_release_id=#{ruleReleaseId} ), jobs AS ( SELECT count(1) FILTER (WHERE j.operation_code IN ('COLLECT','RETRY_FILES') AND j.job_status_code IN ('SCOPE_READY','PENDING','RUNNING','RETRY_WAIT','PAUSED')) AS frozen_collection_job_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE j.operation_code IN ('COLLECT','RETRY_FILES') AND j.job_status_code='RUNNING') AS running_collection_job_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE j.application_status_code='PENDING') AS application_pending_job_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE j.rollback_action_id IS NOT NULL AND j.rollback_status_code='NOT_REQUESTED') AS rollback_pending_job_count FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j JOIN announcement_source_snapshots s ON s.id=j.source_id WHERE s.data_purpose_code='PRODUCTION' AND j.rule_release_id=#{ruleReleaseId} ), plans AS ( -- FROZEN 계획은 누적 이력이다. 현재 실행 중인 run 수나 향후 HTTP 요청 수가 아니다. SELECT count(1) AS frozen_collection_plan_count FROM announcement_attachment_collection_plans p JOIN announcement_source_collection_runs r ON r.id=p.run_id JOIN announcement_source_collection_requests q ON q.id=r.request_id WHERE p.plan_status_code='FROZEN' AND q.data_purpose_code='PRODUCTION' AND p.rule_release_id=#{ruleReleaseId} ) SELECT sources.bound_source_count,sources.review_required_source_count,sources.effective_attachment_source_count,sources.linked_source_count, jobs.frozen_collection_job_count,jobs.running_collection_job_count,jobs.application_pending_job_count,jobs.rollback_pending_job_count, plans.frozen_collection_plan_count FROM sources CROSS JOIN jobs CROSS JOIN plans
